ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The file on China is kept in drawer 5. ... The file on Kenya is kept in drawer 9. ... The file on Denmark is kept in drawer 7. ... Which drawer holds the file on the country whose capital is Copenhagen?" -> answer org 7; the alt prompt asks about the Kenya (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 9 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 5 (answer at the same statement slot), 3 (the alt prompt's own answer), 7 (answer org kept).
